preconditions: source identity and coordinate match the normalized record
decisionLogic: Show the source location and a detached relative-depth log. Do not place interval elevations at a section station and do not create contacts.
uncertainty: All source evidence and datum/accuracy states remain unchanged.
validationMethod: positive render plus direct-role and coordinate-mismatch rejection tests
reopenCondition: A regional-context display is proposed as section geometry or a new borehole role is added.
